headword: {動体視力|どうたいしりょく}
gloss: dynamic visual acuity; ability to follow moving objects

definitions.gloss: dynamic visual acuity; ability to follow moving objects
definitions.explanation: The ability to see moving things clearly and follow them with the eyes, important in ball sports and in driving.
